title: Authentication, Participant Binding, Membership Verification and Operator Authority
scope: external authenticated identity remains distinct from canonical Participant identity
provider identity may bind to a Participant only through explicit authorized action
membership verification requires real delegated authority
active member access requires both authenticated issuer+subject binding and active membership
fresh authentication evidence is permitted for the same bound issuer+subject tuple

invariants.INV-001: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened at SW1 product boundary: UI/auth-provider access is not authority; identity.bind and membership.verify require AuthorityEvaluator approval.
invariants.INV-002: No promotion. External provider principal/evidence remains typed input and cannot outrank canonical Participant or membership records.
invariants.INV-030: No promotion. Authentication subject is explicitly prevented from silently becoming Participant identity by implementation convention.

negativePaths: issuer/subject delimiter-collision impersonation rejected by injective tuple encoding
